verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents a data-export feature, but there is indirect support for leaving. Blink is open source and self-buildable (blink-shell-gh-2, blink-shell-gh-4, blink-shell-comm-7). It uses standard SSH key types (blink-shell-docs-1) and ships scp, sftp, curl and cp, which can move files out (blink-shell-gh-1, blink-shell-gh-5, blink-shell-docs-4). missing for 10: a documented export of hosts, keys and settings in open formats, any evidence that all app data can be exported, and independent hands-on confirmation of migrating away.
